parent_objective: offline behavior cloning from L2 teacher targets into an L3 online-GRU student

public_gates: implement offline L3 behavior-cloning optimizer from M562-style corpora
preserve P0 72-value student input and L3 online-GRU metadata
write train and validation action MSE artifacts
do not run PPO or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train from public frozen-source rows
do not feed L2 stacked observations into the L3 student
do not add hidden parameters or oracle labels
do not promote a checkpoint before route-screen v2
hypothesis: An offline behavior-cloning optimizer can transfer the strong L2 finite-window action prior into an L3 online-GRU actor while keeping the deployable P0 actor contract clean.
success_criteria: optimizer loads M562-style student_obs_seq and teacher_action_seq arrays
optimizer trains an L3 online-GRU checkpoint with P0 72-value inputs
train and validation teacher-action MSE improve versus initialization
tests cover recurrent hidden reset masks and student input dimension checks
failure_criteria: optimizer consumes teacher stacked observations as student input
checkpoint metadata no longer declares P0 L3 online-GRU
validation MSE does not improve in the smoke run
optimizer runs PPO or route-screen selection in this milestone

commands.name: tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_l3_behavior_cloning.py tests/test_l2_teacher_corpus.py

decision_rule: M563 passes because the offline L3 behavior-cloning optimizer improves teacher-action MSE on train and validation M562-style corpora without actor-input leakage, PPO, route-screen selection, or checkpoint promotion.
